Candidate coverage, photos & probability rules

Profiles show named outcomes listed by Polymarket, not a certified or exhaustive ballot roster. Unnamed party outcomes are explicitly labeled. Direct individual-candidate markets take priority when available for a race. Major-party contracts generally settle on the party’s nominee, including a replacement; use each card’s source link for its exact rules. Minor-party and independent candidates appear when the source lists them.

Odds are Yes outcome prices, quoted independently without normalization. They may not sum to 100%, do not measure vote share, and are not ML forecasts. Closed or non-trading markets show no current probability. Retrieval time is not the last trade time. After two hours, old values are labeled stale. Scheduled GitHub refreshes update the snapshot hourly; Refresh profiles reloads the latest published snapshot.

Images are supplied by Polymarket or matched by full name and state to public-domain congressional portraits from unitedstates/images, using congress-legislators identifiers. Missing or failed images show initials and “Photo unavailable.” Names, pictures and quotes refresh with source availability. No face recognition is used.

60-DAY WALK-FORWARD TEST

Which model tracks best?

Mean absolute error in percentage points. Lower is better. The selected method was chosen before this test window.

RANDOM FOREST · FEATURE IMPORTANCE

What the forest uses

Relative importance in the fitted forest; not causal influence or importance for other models.

Impurity-based importance can be biased and shared between correlated inputs. Zero values mean the forest made no useful splits.

PREDICTION VS. OBSERVATION

Put the forecast to the test.

Actual daily closeForecast made one day earlier

Methodology, full metrics & limitations

All three models use current price, 1-, 3- and 7-day changes, and 7-day volatility. They predict the next daily change; the ensemble averages their three price forecasts. Each party and chamber is trained separately. No polls, election labels or fundamentals are included.

Thirty earlier validation days choose the method by MAE. The following sixty days evaluate it without reselecting on the test results. Each forecast uses only observations available at its origin; models refit as new daily labels become available. The no-change method can win.

MethodValidation MAETest MAETest RMSEDirection hit rateNext close

Direction hit rate excludes unchanged actual days. Predicting no change is a miss on moving days. It is not election accuracy. MAE and RMSE are in percentage points. No calibrated uncertainty interval or election-outcome accuracy is claimed. Completed candles only; gaps and invalid prices are excluded.

BEHIND THE NUMBERS

A market snapshot.
Not a certainty.

Polymarket supplies Yes outcome prices. Kalshi and PredictIt use the midpoint between the best Yes bid and ask. Prices reflect traders’ expectations; fees, liquidity and settlement rules can cause differences.

Sources, timing & calculation

Prices are shown independently and may not add to 100%. The market average is a simple descriptive mean of the sources shown as eligible in the table, without normalization or accuracy weighting.

“Retrieved” records a successful API retrieval, not the last trade. After two hours a snapshot is marked stale and excluded from the average. Quote timestamps are not consistently supplied. A failed request retains the earlier snapshot and its original time.

Polymarket can refresh directly while this page is open. All sources and the README refresh through GitHub Actions hourly; schedules may be delayed. The model retrains after its daily forecast expires. Browser refresh reloads saved data too.
